angle: An audit of what a solo operator actually needs to pay for
hook: 11 free tools that replace paid subscriptions
caption:
I went through every recurring charge on my card and asked one question of each: is there a free tool that does eighty percent of this. Eleven times the answer was yes. This is that list, with what you give up in each case — because there is always something.

💬 Comment "AUDIT" and I'll send you the full list.
🔖 Save this for the next time you need it.
➡️ Follow @profit_prompts_ for the AI stack that actually pays.

#freetools #saas #solopreneur #productivity #sidehustle #business

slides.subline: A solo operator's stack, audited line by line

slides.text: Subscriptions do not feel expensive one at a time. Add the year up once and the number is genuinely upsetting.

slides.title: Audit by the year, not the month
slides.body: Nine dollars a month reads as nothing. A hundred and eight a year reads as a decision. Multiply every subscription by twelve before you judge it.

slides.title: Keep what earns
slides.body: This is not about paying for nothing. If a tool directly makes you money, keep it and stop optimising. Cut the ones you kept because cancelling was mildly annoying.
